The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (December 21, 2017) from the Director, Purchasing and Materials Management: Call Number: Request for Quotation No. 6612-17-7295 Description: For the non-exclusive supply and delivery of Sulphur Dioxide for the City of Toronto's Water Division from January 1, 2018 to December 31, 2019, with the option to renew the Contract for three (3) additional and separate one (1) year periods. Should the option(s) to renew be exercised, then the General Manager, Toronto Water Division will request the Director of Purchasing and Materials Management to process the necessary contract renewals under the same terms and conditions.
